'''Klára Anna Verseghy''' (2 February 1930 – 3 November 2020) was a Hungarian [[lichenologist]]. She was the [[curator]] of the lichen collection of the [[Hungarian Natural History Museum]] in [[Budapest]] from 1958 to 1985.<ref name="Farkas et al. 2021"/>

==Biography==

Klára Verseghy was born in [[Budapest]] on 2 February 1930 to parents Károly Verseghy (an officer) and Gabriella Uhlai. All of her education was undertaken in Budapest, including elementary, secondary grammar school, and university. She graduated from [[Eötvös Loránd University]] in 1953 as a teacher of biology and chemistry. Soon after she started employment at the [[Hungarian Natural History Museum]]. After starting as a librarian, in 1958 she became curator of the lichen collections, assuming a position previously held by prominent Hungarian lichenologist [[Ödön Szatala]]. She held this position for 32 years, until her retirement in 1985.<ref name="Farkas et al. 2021"/>

In 1958, she defended her thesis {{lang|hu|Az európai Ochrolechia fajok monográfiája}} ("Monograph of the European Ochrolechia species") under her supervisor Szatala.<ref name="Farkas Lőkös Varga Veres 2021"/>

As part of her work in the lichen herbarium, Verseghy curated the extensive collections of [[Ferenc Fóriss]], [[Vilmos Kőfaragó-Gyelnik]] and Szatala in the classification system proposed by [[Alexander Zahlbruckner]]. She separated the [[type (biology)|type]] specimens, and in 1964 used this collection to compile the type catalogue of the lichen collection, which ended up numbering more than 1000 specimens. Verseghy collected about 5,000 lichen specimens in several areas of Hungary, including [[Bakony]], [[Hortobágy]], [[Kiskunság]], {{ill|Vendvidék|hu}}, [[Villány Mountains]], [[Zemplén Mountains]]. An additional 1,500 specimens were from abroad–Finland, Norway, Poland, Romania, Slovakia, Sweden, Turkey and Ukraine were collecting destinations. Between 1969 and 1981 she issued two [[exsiccata]]e, namely ''Lichenotheca parva'' and ''Lichenes exsiccati, editi a sectione botanica musei historico-naturalis Hungarici''.<ref>{{cite web |title=Lichenotheca parva: IndExs ExsiccataID=784468114 |website=IndExs – Index of Exsiccatae |publisher=Botanische Staatssammlung München |url=https://www.botanischestaatssammlung.de/DatabaseClients/IndExs/Exsiccatae_IndExs_Details.jsp?ExsiccataID=784468114 |access-date=29 April 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Lichenes exsiccati, editi a sectione botanica musei historico-naturalis Hungarici: IndExs ExsiccataID=233070910 |website=IndExs – Index of Exsiccatae |publisher=Botanische Staatssammlung München |url=https://www.botanischestaatssammlung.de/DatabaseClients/IndExs/Exsiccatae_IndExs_Details.jsp?ExsiccataID=233070910 |access-date=29 April 2024}}</ref>   She published more than a hundred scientific and popular papers mainly on [[floristics]], [[taxonomy (biology)|taxonomy]], [[plant physiology]], and [[bioindicator|bioindication]]. Verseghy introduced 46 new [[taxon|taxa]] (19 species, 27 [[variety (botany)|varieties]] and [[form (botany)|forms]]) and 69 [[new combination]]s. She published taxonomic revisions of species from the genera ''[[Caloplaca]]'', ''[[Gasparrinia]]'', ''[[Ochrolechia]]'', ''[[Squamaria]]'', and ''[[Squamarina]]''.<ref name="Farkas et al. 2021"/> Together with Edit Láng she initiated ecophysiological research on Hungarian lichens.<ref name="Lőkös et al. Farkas 1999"/>

She prepared her main work, ''Magyarország zuzmó órájának kézikönyve'' ("The handbook of the Hungarian lichen flora") in 1994, during her retirement;<ref name="Farkas et al. 2021"/> this work contained descriptions of 715 lichens found in Hungary.<ref name="Lőkös et al. Farkas 1999"/>

==Selected publications==
Verseghy had 106 publications, including 23 that were about popular subjects; a complete listing in given in [[Edit Éva Farkas|Farkas]] and colleagues' 2021 obituary. Some representative works are listed:<ref name="Farkas et al. 2021"/>

*{{cite journal |last1=Verseghy |first1=K. |year=1959 |title=Studien über die Gattung ''Ochrolechia'' III. Angaben zur Chemie der ''Ochrolechia''-Arten |journal=Annales Historico-Naturales Musei Nationalis Hungarici |volume=51 |pages=145–159 |language=de}}
*{{cite journal |last1=Verseghy |first1=K. |year=1962 |title=Die Gattung ''Ochrolechia''|journal=Nova Hedwigia, Beihefte |volume=1 |pages=1–146 |language=de}}

*{{cite journal |last1=Verseghy |first1=K. |year=1968 |title=Nachtrag I. zum "Typenverzeichnis der Flechtensammlung in der Botanischen Abteilung des aUngarischen Naturwissenscha lichen Museums" |journal=Fragmenta Botanica |volume=6 |issue=1–4 |pages=41–55 |language=de}}

==Eponyms==
The lichen genus ''[[Verseghya]]'' {{small|S.Y.Kondr., Lőkös & Hur (2016)}} and the species ''[[Verseghya klarae]]'' {{small|S.Y. Kondr., Lőkös & Hur (2016)}}, ''[[Nectriopsis verseghy-klarae]]'' {{small|S.Y.Kondr., Lőkös & Hur (2016)}},<ref name="Kondratyuk et al. 2016"/> and ''[[Opegrapha verseghyklarae]]'' {{small|S.Y.Kondr., Lőkös & Hur (2015)}}<ref name="Kondratyuk et al. 2015"/> are [[eponym|named after]] her.<ref name="Hertel et al. 2017"/>
